item.title: House passes Russia sanctions, sending bill named for Lindsey Graham to Trump's desk
item.description: The legislation was named for the late South Carolina Republican. It gives the president authority to impose tariffs on top importers of oil and natural gas from Russia, such as China and India.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Committee investigating Epstein holds billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress
item.description: Billionaire investor Leon Black refused to appear before the committee investigating convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein for a deposition. Now it's up to the Department of Justice whether to pursue criminal charges.

item.title: A tumultuous congressional primary season closes with record departures and defeats
item.description: Already, close to 100 lawmakers who started this Congress will not be around for the next one, according to an NPR analysis, driven by record-setting retirements and primary defeats.

item.title: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
item.description: The New Yorker's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.

item.title: Rep. Thomas Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the Iran war
item.description: Rep. Thomas Massie has moved to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The Kentucky Republican alleges that Hegseth has waged the Iran war illegally, among other "high crimes and misdemeanors."
